items.text:
We are excited to announce the release of version 2.5 of our flagship software, CodeGuard. This update includes performance improvements, bug fixes, and a new dashboard. The release is scheduled for August 15. Users will be notified via email. For detailed release notes, visit our website. The support team is available for any questions.

In preparation, please ensure your systems meet the new requirements. The update will be rolled out automatically. No action is required from most users.
